brief:
Palestinian Authority officials in Ramallah are grappling with rival proposals over candidate lists as legislative elections scheduled for November approach, with the imprisoned leader Marwan Barghouti at the center of ongoing internal deliberations, Shehab Wire reported. Disputes over candidacy and electoral positioning have dominated discussions within PA leadership offices as the vote draws nearer.

European officials have issued warnings to the Palestinian Authority against postponing the scheduled elections. The caution from international partners reflects pressure on PA leadership to move forward with the November ballot despite the unresolved disagreements over candidate selection and political alignments that continue to complicate preparations for the vote.
